message: Toy-town diorama navigation prototype ready. Demo Glorieta Minerva -> Estadio Jalisco (changed from the airport, reasons in README): fastest route crosses 15 hazard features, the safe route (shared cauce. router, default hazard set) avoids them for about +4 min. Mid-drive reroute, 2+ flood alerts, 30 s ?demo=1 with window.__cauceDemo {duration_s:30, seek(t)}. Own building tiles: Overture footprints with INEGI 5 m nDSM median heights (36 MB MVT z13-15).
